title: A WRAPPED CONTRACT HANGS ITS SECOND LINE
why: Seen on the 4K raid screenshot of 2026-10-08 after v19.82: the second line of a wrapped contract in the CONDITIONS box started at the same margin as the next contract, so 1x Data Core 0/1 read as a contract of its own. Second lines now hang a little to the right, and the wrap leaves them the room so they stay inside the box.
now: In the CONDITIONS box a contract that runs to two lines is easy to tell from the next one.

edits.anchor: var ck=ctx.font+'|'+inner+'|'+t, best, n, lo, hi, mid, tr, it;
edits.replacement: var ck=ctx.font+'|'+inner+'|'+t, best, n, lo, hi, mid, tr, it, IND=Math.round(LH(8));   // v16.xx: IND, the hanging indent of a second line
